metadata.title: Jubilé de Monsieur le Professeur Amé Pictet

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features moderate contrast between thick and thin strokes, slanted serifs, and a humanist influence in the letterforms (such as the rounded bowls and the shape of the 'e'), which are characteristic of Old Style faces common in early 20th-century academic printing.
